brief:
Middle East Eye reported that UK Foreign Secretary David Miliband has announced a reset of Britain's Israel policy, though observers say the substantive test of the shift lies in implementation. The announcement comes as Palestine solidarity activists continue mobilizing around the government's approach to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

Activists are being called to maintain pressure on the UK government beyond the initial policy announcement, according to the outlet, suggesting skepticism that rhetorical shifts will translate into concrete diplomatic or aid changes without sustained public mobilization.

title: UK Palestine activists urged to sustain pressure after Miliband policy reset
